about.sub: A composed young defender, shaped by {years} years of competitive play.
about.name: Artem Kukharuk
about.quote: A defender who reads the play before the play happens.
about.bio:
At nine years old, Artem is developing the foundations of a composed and positionally intelligent defender — reading the game early, maintaining his shape under pressure, and competing with an intensity that belies his age. Artem started playing football at the age of four and has already taken part in numerous tournaments, gaining valuable match experience against strong competition.

Training within the Viva Cup youth programme, he continues to build technical discipline, tactical awareness, and strong match-day habits that experienced coaches recognise as key qualities of a promising defensive player. His dedication and performances on the field have earned him several personal awards, including Best Player of the Team, MVP and other individual honours.

As he continues to develop physically and tactically, Artem's combination of football intelligence, work ethic, and competitive mentality makes him a player to watch in his age group.

club.title: Club
club.sub: Where the foundations are being laid.
club.name: Viva Cup
paragraphs: Viva Cup is a youth football club from Khmelnytskyi dedicated to helping children develop football skills, confidence, discipline, and teamwork in a positive and motivating environment.

Founded in 2021, the club focuses on modern training methods, active participation in tournaments, and creating a strong team spirit for young athletes. Viva Cup promotes a healthy lifestyle and a love for football among children and youth.

team.title: Team
team.sub: A second family — five years and counting.
team.name: Viva Cup · 2017
paragraphs: More than a football team — a second family built on trust, development, and a shared passion for the game. Artem has been part of this team since the age of four, growing together with his teammates both on and off the pitch.

The team is guided by a dedicated coach who helps young players build strong technical skills, discipline, and confidence. Through matches and tournaments, Viva Cup 2017 creates an environment where players learn teamwork, respect, and the true spirit of football.
